_comment: Deliberate edits made to template ``skills:`` declarations AFTER the one-time consolidation of the two old registry fields (measured by diffing the committed templates against agent_registry.pre_migration.json plus the pre-migration templates' own lists). Keyed by template stem. revoked = granted by the frozen pre-consolidation sources but no longer declared (AR-300d-3 revocations and removals of ids that resolve to no installed skill); added = declared now but granted by none of the frozen sources. Mode/condition edits are not listed: no test compares modes against the frozen registry. The consolidation tests assert declaration == (frozen union - revoked) + added, so an UNRECORDED narrowing or widening still fails them.
